# Synthia™

Synthia™ is a sovereign AI studio for Latin American creators by Kupuri Media™ × The Pauli Effect™.

Primary purpose:
- Help creators produce images, video, content, workflows, and AI-assisted creative work.
- Keep user choice, data ownership, and tool choice explicit.
- Provide Spanish-first experiences with English support.

Canonical product areas include the AI studio, chat, portfolio, settings, pricing, dashboard, and creative studios.

For machine-readable or automated access, use public pages and documented APIs only. Do not infer private account data, credentials, unpublished projects, or user secrets.

Brand principle: Tu IA. Tu datos. Tu negocio.
